Title: Why Don't You Look At Me?
Concept: Explaining why forced eye contact impairs auditory processing in autistic children.
Exact_Hook: Dolly, why does our friend look at the wall when we talk?
Conflict_Question: Adults asking child to look into their eyes before speaking.
Educational_Point: Looking away reduces cognitive overload and helps the child listen better.
Dialogue_Summary: Gappu asks why Kabir looks away. Dolly explains that listening is easier when eyes don't have to work.

Title: Why That Sound Hurts
Concept: Auditory hyperacusis explained through a kitchen mixer grinder.
Exact_Hook: Dolly, why did Kabir run away when Maa started the mixer?
Conflict_Question: Mixer grinder noise causing sudden distress and ear-covering.
Educational_Point: Auditory filtering differences mean everyday sounds can feel physically jarring.
Dialogue_Summary: Gappu wonders why a kitchen sound triggers panic. Dolly explains sensory amplification.
CTA: Save this for noisy family events

Title: Why Repeat That Cartoon Line?
Concept: Gestalt language processing and echolalia as meaningful communication.
Exact_Hook: Dolly, why is he repeating Peppa Pig dialogues instead of answering?
Conflict_Question: Child repeats TV script rather than answering 'What is your name?'.
Educational_Point: Echolalia is real language development; the child uses learned scripts to share connection.

Title: Why Does He Spin The Wheels?
Concept: Visual stimming and non-traditional toy exploration.
Exact_Hook: Dolly, why does Kabir flip the toy car upside down and spin wheels?
Conflict_Question: Adults trying to force child to 'drive' car forward on floor.
Educational_Point: Spinning wheels provides soothing visual vestibular feedback; play has many valid forms.
Dialogue_Summary: Gappu watches wheels spin. Dolly explains how visual patterns bring calm to a busy brain.
CTA: Respect all forms of joyful play

Title: Why Does Sitting Still Hurt?
Concept: Proprioceptive seeking and the physical need for movement breaks.
Exact_Hook: Dolly, why does our friend wriggle like a fish on his chair?
Conflict_Question: Teacher demanding child sit perfectly still with hands folded.
Educational_Point: Movement activates neurological focus; stillness can cause internal dysregulation.
Dialogue_Summary: Gappu asks if Kabir is being naughty. Dolly explains the body's hidden hunger for movement.
CTA: Share with your child's class teacher

Title: Why Did Plans Change Melt Him Down?
Concept: The neurological comfort of predictability and fear of unexpected transitions.
Exact_Hook: Dolly, we only changed the park to the mall... why the big tears?
Conflict_Question: Sudden change of destination triggers intense emotional distress.
Educational_Point: Predictability creates safety; sudden changes feel like the ground disappearing.
Dialogue_Summary: Gappu learns why visual transition warnings protect emotional safety.

Title: The Room Isn't Loud To You
Concept: Sensory empathy in crowded shopping malls.
Exact_Hook: The mall isn't too loud for you... but it may feel like thunder to someone else.
Conflict_Question: Shoppers staring at child covering ears near escalator.
Educational_Point: Sensory thresholds vary widely; what is background murmur to one is sensory pain to another.
Dialogue_Summary: Dolly visualizes sound waves expanding into bright jagged sparks; Gappu offers quiet headphones.

Title: Flapping Is My Pure Joy
Concept: Motor stimming as authentic emotional expression of happiness.
Exact_Hook: When hands flutter like butterflies, it's not bad... it's pure happiness overflowing!
Conflict_Question: Well-meaning adult holding child's hands down to stop hand-flapping.
Educational_Point: Motor stimming releases intense emotional energy and regulates internal excitement.
Dialogue_Summary: Dolly shows how dolphin fins splash in joy; Gappu flutters his trunk in celebration.

Title: The Scratchy Tag Monster
Concept: Tactile defensiveness against clothing tags and synthetic fabrics.

Educational_Point: Tactile receptors in neurodivergent skin can register shirt tags as constant irritating pinpricks.
Dialogue_Summary: Dolly shows microscopic view of sharp nylon tag; Gappu snips it off with gentle scissors.

Title: I Hear Everything At Once
Concept: Visualizing lack of sensory auditory gating.

Educational_Point: Without neurological auditory filtration, all background noises compete for equal attention.

Concept: The hidden desire for social connection in non-speaking children.

Concept: Explaining index finger pointing and shared gaze.

Concept: Explaining the muscle & joint sense of body position.

Conflict_Question: Explaining why children push walls, crash into sofas, or stomp their feet.

Title: What Is A Sensory Diet?

Concept: Proprioceptive grounding for homework sitting tolerance.
